**Yes.** An order carrying SPRING15 would fail the same way as order 1003 with SUMMER25.

- **Reason:** `GetOrderTotal` returns early only when `DiscountCode` is null or empty. Any other code goes to `DiscountRates[order.DiscountCode]` on line 18. The dictionary holds only WELCOME10 and VIP20, and a search of the order-service folder finds no SPRING15 entry anywhere, so the lookup throws `KeyNotFoundException`.
- **Confidence: high.** This follows from the code I read. I did not read any order record, so I can't say which orders carry SPRING15.
- **Cause and area:** unchanged. The cause is still the unguarded dictionary index on line 18 in `GetOrderTotal`, and the area is still **code**. The fix is the same: treat an unknown code as no discount. It also covers any other retired code, not just SUMMER25 and SPRING15.

I changed no code, and I recorded this answer with `ReportInvestigation` for run eval-order-total-1003-again-20261127-053832-triage-1.
